summary: Verified iteration-10 changes end-to-end. Backend (5/5 pytest pass): cold /api/inspire calls for dessert/snack/breakfast return exactly 4 valid recipes with full rich schema (yield_text, ingredients_detailed[name+quantity], nutrition ints, image_query), typical latency 10-12s under gpt-4o-mini + JSON mode. Cache HIT for dessert returns 4 recipes in ~92ms. refresh=true bypasses cache and returns 4 recipes with fresh IDs (disjoint from cached IDs). No _extract_json fallback errors in backend logs. Frontend on /inspire (dinner cold): inspire-loading container shows exactly 4 recipe-card-skeletons within 500ms, counter reads 'Cooking up ideas…'; after ~10s skeletons disappear and grid renders 4 real cards. Load-more button 'Load 4 more ideas' visible under grid; on click, button text swaps to 'Fetching more ideas…' with spinner AND 4 skeletons are appended in the grid; after fetch, grid grew 4→7 (1 dedup) then 7→11 on 2nd click (dedup working, no toast needed because net-new > 0). All data-testids match spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Same standing pre-existing note: /api/inspire cache is keyed only on category, so a warm 4-count doc will serve later count=10 callers with only 4 items. Not a regression this iteration.
loadMore dedups by id+lowercased title, so if the LLM returns very similar titles with different case/emoji they'll still slip through — acceptable trade-off.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (cold skeleton, real cards, load-more append+dedup, button text swap all verified)
